purpose: Teach: 宝塚/グローブ/ジャンク/アリア/運勢/グレイ/悪人/グレン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが宝塚歌劇のチケットを下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he'd give you a ticket to the Takarazuka Revue.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle lift on the news — she's sharing something she knows will matter to him. Natural pause before 'ticket' like she's letting the gift land.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと野球のグローブの手入れ方法習ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me how to take care of my baseball glove.
lines.style: Bright, earnest excitement. Quick pace. The specific pride of learning something new from his father. Small forward lean in the voice, eager to share.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ジャンクフードは月一にね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying junk food should be just once a month.
lines.style: Gentle observation, not instruction. Slight amusement in the tone — she's relaying something practical he said. Calm, matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとアリアのコンサート観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to see an Aria concert.
lines.style: Steady happiness. No rush — he's savoring the memory. The specific joy of something shared and witnessed together. Soft contentment in the trailing off.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「今日の運勢は良い」って笑ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was laughing about how your fortune for today was good.
lines.style: Tender amusement. She's picturing him laughing — warmth showing through her voice. Light, almost conspiratorial, like she's sharing a small moment of his character with her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとグレイのコートを買いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went to buy a gray coat together.
lines.style: Calm satisfaction. A simple activity rendered meaningful by the doing together. No rushing. The quiet pride of being included in an everyday errand.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「漫画の悪人キャラも魅力がある」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that even the villains in manga have their charm.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost contemplative. She's relaying something that shows his depth. Slight warmth — she appreciates this about him. Measured pace, letting the idea breathe.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとグレン・ミラー楽団のCD聴いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I listened to a Glenn Miller Orchestra CD together.
lines.style: Warm, settled happiness. The contentment of shared listening, shared taste. Gentle voice, like he's still hearing the music. Close, intimate tone — the conversation winding down on something good.
